Triage first-touch grading (triage seat, daily round 2026-08-27, session `session_01Czs5tCwMymUvzB9QCA2yhH`): **promoted** `finding` → `pm:queue`, type **Task**, routed `domain:engine` (fix lands in `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`).

Rationale: S-class prose-consistency repair with a worked sibling — after #12563 the automation side renders the same ADR-0005 shadowing fact with single quotes; this is the one remaining site telling the same story in the other spelling, and it is a minority spelling inside its own package (170-to-37 measured). Fix is the one-character class plus whatever pin the objectql suite already holds on this message text. Serial-constraint note for the claiming seat: `registry.ts` is a hot file — check the engine lane's hot-file queue and any in-flight claims naming it before dispatch; this card folds cheaply into any sibling already holding that file (five-gate family fold applies).

**Claim:** `domain:engine` PM seat (#6367), session `session_01LZbWd2jNV1FErXTPSS4Dry`, branch `claude/issue-12609-registry-collision-quote-style`.

**Serial constraints cleared:** `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` — #12623 held it and landed as `21196cf6`, verified by content on `origin/main` with markers checked absent beforehand (`#12623` 0→3, `namespace && packageId` 0→1) and a positive control (#12732's `emitterWouldVarchar` = 2). No open PR holds the file now.

Triage's serial note (`5435167463`) is the reason this card waited rather than going out with the earlier batch. It said the fix "folds cheaply into any sibling already holding that file" — true, but only **at dispatch time**. By the time this seat had a free slot, #12778 was already reviewed and mid-CI, so folding would have discarded a completed review and bought a full CI cycle for a one-character-class change. It ships on its own instead.

Worth noting the constraint was not just inferred: `No other open PR may claim the same single-writer path` ran **green** on #12778 precisely because it was the only open PR holding `registry.ts`. Opening this one alongside it would have turned that check red.

### Scope

The one message, and nothing else. ⛔ The measured 170-to-37 minority-spelling count is **context for why this spelling is the odd one out — not a licence to sweep the package.** A quote-style sweep across `objectql` is a different card and would bury this one-line fix in noise.

Before writing anything: find the pin the `objectql` suite already holds on this message text. Sibling precedent is #12563, which made the same ADR-0005 shadowing fact render with single quotes on the automation side — if that PR moved or added a pin, this one should match its shape rather than invent a new one.
